_provenance.what: Candidate working point of the Longquanshan delivery chain with the discriminative candidate gate (area / sum / tag) wired in but DISABLED.  The frozen delivery file (manu/evaluation/system_sota_longquan_delivery_params.json) is untouched; this is a new file.
_provenance.source: manu/evaluation/system_sota_longquan_delivery_params.json -- the 'params' block is copied verbatim (every frozen value is byte-identical, only the new 'cand_gate' key was added) -- plus the out-of-sample sweep manu/evaluation/sweep_decision_layer.py (decision_sweep/20261105_093017_k2k3_oos, sum_quantile_scope=exclude-primary).
_provenance.usage: python manu/evaluation/system_sota_longquan.py --params-json <this file> --seqs <pool> ...  The behaviour is identical to the frozen file while cand_gate.enabled is false.

cand_gate.what: A per-candidate predicate applied to the candidates that survived the cross-scale de-duplication (gate_stage=post): area >= area_min AND sums >= sum_value AND tag in tag_allow.
cand_gate.form: sum_mode='abs': an ABSOLUTE energy floor (sums >= 10.0).  It is a hard constant, so it does not depend on any dataset distribution and needs no per-tag quantile table (thresholds is empty).  This makes it the distribution-free form of the gate and the one that can be shipped as a fixed threshold.  The per-tag quantile form lives in the separate file manu/evaluation/system_sota_longquan_candgate_oos.json.
cand_gate.how_the_threshold_was_chosen: The absolute floor was picked on the evaluation pools of the out-of-sample sweep (decision_sweep/20261105_093017_k2k3_oos).  It was chosen on the evaluation set, therefore the evidence as a whole stays EXPLORATORY -- but, unlike a quantile, the constant itself carries no dataset-specific calibration, so it transfers between arms and sequences.
cand_gate.status: EXPLORATORY EVIDENCE -- NOT RELEASED, NOT ONLINE, NOT A DELIVERY

measured_out_of_sample.note: All rows below are the out-of-sample sweep (the blind hold-out is excluded from the quantile population; the absolute floor needs no population at all).  area_min=1, tag_allow=[0,1,2], th_base=0.30 (frozen), gate_stage=post.  'T2 hard gate' is the current gate chain rule on the golden pool: F1 >= 0.985 and FP <= 112.

cs_t0008p2.verdict: T3 +1.0213 pp, the golden pool still clears the hard gate

trial_0049.verdict: T3 still improves, but sums >= 20 breaks the T2 hard gate on this arm -- do not apply this value to trial_0049; sums >= 10 is the arm-robust value.

abs_sums_ge_10_arm_robust.verdict: sums >= 10 improves T3 and keeps the T2 hard gate on BOTH arms.

in_sample_measurement.warning: These are the numbers the first (in-sample) sweep reported.  Their energy quantile population INCLUDES the blind hold-out, i.e. the blind sequence helped define the threshold that is then applied to it.

why_the_in_sample_optimum_fails_out_of_s.fact: The configuration that was selected INSIDE the sample (tagq q0.2 for trial_0049, tagq q0.3 for cs_t0008p2) FAILS out of sample and breaks the T2 hard gate, so it was DISCARDED.
why_the_in_sample_optimum_fails_out_of_s.root_cause: The blind hold-out contributes many low-energy candidates, so the in-sample quantile is much lower than the golden-pool quantile (tag 0 at q0.2 for trial_0049: 14.947647 in-sample vs 28.321567 out-of-sample).  The in-sample threshold therefore removes mostly blind-sequence noise, while the out-of-sample threshold also removes real candidates.
why_the_in_sample_optimum_fails_out_of_s.consequence: The gate itself is NOT invalidated -- only the in-sample level was.  Re-selecting the level out of sample keeps the gain: tagq q0.05 on trial_0049 (T3 +0.3385 pp, T2 hard gate PASS) and tagq q0.10 on cs_t0008p2 (T3 +1.0097 pp, T2 hard gate PASS); the absolute floor sums >= 10 keeps the T2 hard gate on both arms and the absolute floor sums >= 20 is the strongest point on cs_t0008p2.

evidence.status_of_the_whole_result: Choosing WHICH energy level to use was still done on the evaluation pools, so the evidence as a whole remains EXPLORATORY.  The gate ships disabled and is not a delivery.

_provenance.note: The frozen delivery configuration is a separate file and was NOT edited in place.  This file is a new working point.  While cand_gate.enabled is false the pipeline is bit-identical to the frozen chain.

cand_gate.threshold_scope: not applicable: the absolute energy floor is a hard constant (sums >= 10.0), it does not depend on any dataset distribution and therefore needs no per-tag quantile table
cand_gate.reference_arm: both delivery members (cs_t0008p2 = runs/nogmc_t3/swa/gate/cs_t0008p2, trial_0049 = runs/nogmc_t3/trials/trial_0049/gate/epoch20).  The floor 10.0 is the only absolute value that keeps the T2 hard gate on BOTH arms; the stricter 20.0 is better on cs_t0008p2 (T3 +1.0213 pp) but BREAKS the T2 hard gate on trial_0049 (T2 F1 0.9785 < 0.985) and is therefore not shipped as the default.
cand_gate.note: The gate is a post-processing step on the merged candidate pool (after the cross-scale de-duplication, before the score threshold).  It changes no frozen parameter: th_base, dedup_radius and the rest of the params block are byte-identical to the frozen delivery file.  The gate ships DISABLED -- see _provenance.cand_gate.evidence for the measured numbers and for the arm each configuration is valid on.
